description_en: Call DescribeMPULayoutInfoList to retrieve layout parameters for a bypass live streaming task
description_zh: 调用DescribeMPULayoutInfoList获取旁路直播任务布局参数
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-mpu-layout-info-list --app-id yourAppId --layout-id 2 --name LayoutName --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMPULayoutInfoList

parameters.description_en: Application ID. You can specify only one ID. Create or view IDs in the console.
parameters.description_zh: 应用ID。仅支持传单个ID，您可以在控制台创建和查询。
parameters.help_en: Application ID. You can specify only one ID. Create or view IDs in the console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。仅支持传单个ID，您可以在控制台创建和查询
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: Layout ID. To get a layout ID, see [CreateMPULayout](~~162192~~).
parameters.help_en: Layout ID. To get a layout ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/162192.html
parameters.name: layout_id

parameters.description_en: Number of entries per page. Default value: **10**.
parameters.help_en: Number of entries per page. Default value: **10**
parameters.name: page_size
